audit_items.proof_trace: The property is enforced by a bidirectional pair of guards: `deposit_ctoken` (L87-89) asserts `!debts.contains(CoinType)` before adding collateral, and `try_borrow_asset` (L121-124) asserts `!is_supporting_collateral(CoinType)` on the first borrow. These complementary guards make the state where both `debts.contains(A)` and `is_supporting_collateral(A)` are true simultaneously unreachable by construction, so the second-borrow path (which skips the collateral check) can never execute while A is a collateral.
